Belly Foods

A one stop mobile app for all the foodies in Nepal. Search restaurants and order today.

Project Overview

Belly app is a revolutionary food service platform that has something for everyone. Whether you're a food vendor looking to expand your reach or a customer looking for a quick and easy way to order food, Belly has you covered.

My Roles
  • Defined the goals of UX research.
  • Conducted user interviews and surveys to understand customer needs and pain points.
  • Designed the overall layout and navigation of the app to make it easy for users to find and order their favorite dishes.
  • Collaborated with the marketing team to create promotional materials and campaigns that drive app usage and retention.

The ultimate food ordering app for dine-in and takeaway! With Belly Foods, you can browse menus from your favorite local restaurants, place orders for pickup or delivery, and even pay securely from your phone. Our easy-to-use interface makes it simple to find exactly what you're looking for, whether it's a classic burger and fries or a gourmet sushi roll. Plus, with real-time updates on the status of your order, you'll always know when to expect your food.

For vendors, Belly offers a simple and intuitive interface that allows you to add and manage your menus, update your restaurant's information, and track orders in real-time. With Belly, you can offer your customers a variety of options including take-out, dine-in, and delivery. You can even use Belly's promotional tools to attract new customers and increase sales.

For customers, Belly makes it easy to discover new restaurants and explore menus. With a few taps of your phone, you can find the perfect restaurant and place an order for take-out, dine-in, or delivery. You can also use Belly to earn credits and rewards, track your orders, and read and write reviews.
